svg.title: Fifty-customer pilot: proposed AWS service design
svg.desc: Proposed design, not implemented. Amazon Cognito issues identity tokens. API Gateway uses a Cognito authorizer. API Lambda saves scoped jobs in RDS PostgreSQL and publishes them to SQS. Worker Lambda computes SQL reports, explains facts with the existing model vendor, and applies one shared carrier limiter. RDS also holds versioned caches, access records and quota counters. S3 stores documents. Lambda jobs ingest carrier data and index documents. The vector service remains an external vendor. CloudWatch records job and tenant metrics. The AWS boundary shows managed services, not VPC or subnet placement.
svg.text: Proposed architecture; not implemented / Same system as the C4 view
